entities.summary: Habsburg, a notable figure in the history of Czechia, associated with Habsburg Rule & the Thirty Years' War (1526–1618). Preceded by Early Habsburg Rule & Counter-Reformation. Their legacy influenced Defenestration of Prague (May 23, 1618) — triggers Thirty Years' War and Battle of White Mountain (November 8, 1620) — end of Czech independence.
